items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I had Keg Purnell with me... He stayed with me until he died. He was a wonderful drummer... When I went into the Frolic he stayed with me for eleven years.

ctx.x: (Inaudible) I had Keg Purnell with me, and Sy (inaudible). He stayed with me until he died. He was a wonderful drummer.
When did you first get him? What year?
